title: The Unexpected Scholarship
author: Emrys Sandoval
blurb: Jude Winterbourne, a coder whose anonymous account knows too much, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. Then grandma's recipe box contains directions that aren't for food — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must decide who to be when the labels come off, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
